items.title: Impressive take there by Aliyah Boston. Two hard dribbles from the left arc down the middle of the paint, then switched the ball to her left hand and finished the layup.
items.author: Scott Agness
items.body_excerpt:
Impressive take there by Aliyah Boston. Two hard dribbles from the left arc down the middle of the paint, then switched the ball to her left hand and finished the layup.

Plus, her sharp-shooting continues from range.

She's only in Season 4.
